response.sql: WITH cat AS (SELECT category, AVG(CASE WHEN spent IS NOT NULL AND spent <> 0 AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount <> 0 THEN (spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount END) AS avg_rel_overspend, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM budget GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(line_count * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM cat), kept AS (SELECT c.category, c.avg_rel_overspend, c.line_count, o.avg_cnt FROM cat c CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE c.line_count > o.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(avg_rel_overspend) AS avg_of_avg_relative_overspend, AVG(line_count * 1.0) AS avg_line_count, AVG(line_count - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM kept
